title: The 33rd Annual Urhobo Progress Union America National Convention 2026
location: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel, Lawrenceburg, Indiana
summary: The premier annual diaspora gathering of Urhobo Progress Union America hosted by UPU Ohio. Bringing together delegates, royal traditional rulers, cultural dancers, and youth leaders from across the United States and Canada.
pricing: Adult Pass: $150 · Child Pass (3-12 yrs): $50 · Under 2: Free
contactPerson: Chief Samuel Ogaga & UPU Ohio Host Committee
highlights: Royal reception and keynote addresses by Urhobo traditional rulers
Executive Council and Board of Trustees annual general legislative assembly
UPUAYA Diaspora Youth Congress and STEM innovation showcase
Grand National Cultural Gala Banquet and awards presentation
description: Iniovo Wadoo! Urhobo Progress Union America (UPUA) proudly announces the 2026 33rd Annual National Convention hosted by UPU Ohio at the DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel in Lawrenceburg, Indiana. Join national delegates, traditional monarchs from Delta State, youth ambassadors, and diaspora families for 5 monumental days celebrating Urhobo heritage, leadership, and prosperity.

title: UPUA Annual Golf Outing & Scramble Tournament
summary: Join fellow diaspora leaders, chapter executives, and guests for the inaugural UPUA Convention Golf Outing at the scenic Dearborn Country Club.
pricing: $100 per Golfer (includes green fees, shared cart, range balls & awards lunch)
highlights: 18-hole scramble tournament format with luxury prizes
Longest drive, closest to pin, and hole-in-one challenges
Buffet networking lunch and awards ceremony
description: Kick off the 2026 Convention weekend on the greens! Whether you are a scratch golfer or weekend enthusiast, enjoy fraternity and friendly competition with Urhobo diaspora professionals.

title: Grand Cultural Gala Night & Royal Banquet
summary: The pinnacle evening of the 33rd Annual Convention. Authentic 3-course Urhobo banquet, royal dignitaries reception, keynote addresses, and rich cultural music & dance gala.
pricing: Adult Pass: $150 · Child Pass (3-12 yrs): $50 · Under 2: Free
contactPerson: Gala Committee: Mrs. Evelyn Obire-Egbe & Dr. Abel Okuma
highlights: Authentic Urhobo traditional cuisine and fine hospitality
Live cultural dance troupes, royal drummers, and musical entertainment
Annual Merit Awards and presidential felicitation
description: Celebrate heritage and unity in royal grand style. The National Cultural Gala & Banquet is the premier cultural showcase of the Urhobo diaspora in North America.

title: UPUAYA North America Youth & STEM Mentorship Congress
summary: Career acceleration, tech mentorship, and leadership panels organized by the UPUAYA National Youth Executive Committee.
highlights: Mentorship breakout circles with Urhobo executives in medicine, law, engineering, and tech
STEM and Artificial Intelligence innovation showcase
Youth Wing national executive planning session
description: Empowering the next generation of Urhobo professionals and community builders across North America.
